synthesizedFacts.fact: Salicylic acid is a beta hydroxy acid (BHA) that exfoliates the skin by penetrating deeply to unclog pores and manage excess oil.
Salicylic acid is particularly beneficial for acne-prone and oily skin due to its ability to dissolve excess oil and dead skin cells.
Salicylic acid can be used daily, but frequency should be adjusted based on individual skin type and tolerance.
